texts.preamble: Santosh Singh Bhadoriya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2019 Author: Vishal Mishra Bench: Vishal Mishra
texts.facts: This is second bail application u/S 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail. The applicant has been arrested on 02.08.2019 by Police Station STF, Bhopal, District (Gwalior Unit) in connection with Crime No.12/2019 registered in relation to the offence punishable u/Ss 420, 272, 273 and 120-B of IPC and Sections 51 and 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. I t is alleged by learned counsel for the applicant that earlier bail application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 30.08.2019 passed in M.Cr.C No. 35814/2019 with liberty to repeat after filling of charge sheet. Now, investigation in the matter is over and charge-sheet has been filed on 24.09.2019, therefore, no further custodial interrogation may be necessary.
texts.arguments: He further submits that the matters relating to Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 have been taken into consideration by the Division Bench of Principal Seat of this Court in W.P. No. 21768/2019 (Sudeep Jain Vs. State of M.P. and Ors.), whereby the manner in which the proceedings have been taken by the authorities is held to be illegal. Applicant is ready to abide by all the conditions as may be imposed by this Court. Upon these grounds, he prays for bail. P er contra, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer and submits that earlier bail application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 30.08.2019, however, investigation in the matter is over and charge sheet has been filed. He further submits that merely by filing of charge-sheet does not 2 MCRC-49109-2019 entitle for grant of bail. He fairly submits that there is no other criminal antecedents against the present applicant.
